note: A `from` on a pass after the first (SPEC 3.3.3, the rule for `from` and `to`). The value is not wrong: the walk IS at b when the second pass starts. It is a second spelling of a fact the walk already states, and a walk has one spelling so that a walk read and written back is the same walk, so the highlight is dropped. That is what separates this rule from continuity: a reader that checks only whether the walk joins reads this highlight clean. The diagnostic names the `from` key, because the key the rule forbids is the element at fault.
